text: From the oval shaped flower bed. <break time="0.8s" /> There rose perhaps a hundred stalks. <break time="0.8s" /> Spreading into heart shaped or tongue shaped leaves. <break time="0.8s" /> Half way up. <break time="0.8s" /> And unfurling at the tip. <break time="0.8s" /> Red or blue or yellow petals. <break time="0.8s" /> Marked with spots of color raised upon the surface. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the dim throat of each flower. <break time="0.8s" /> Emerged a straight bar. <break time="0.8s" /> Rough with gold dust. <break time="0.8s" /> And slightly clubbed at the end. <break time="0.8s" /> And the petals were voluminous enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To be stirred by the summer breeze. <break time="0.8s" /> When the petals moved. <break time="0.8s" /> The red, blue, and yellow lights. <break time="0.8s" /> Passed one over the other. <break time="0.8s" /> Staining an inch of the brown earth beneath. <break time="0.8s" /> With a spot of the most intricate color. <break time="0.8s" /> The light fell upon the smooth gray back of a pebble. <break time="0.8s" /> Or the shell of a snail. <break time="0.8s" /> Or, falling into a raindrop. <break time="0.8s" /> It expanded with such intense color. <break time="0.8s" /> That one expected the drop to burst. <break time="0.8s" /> Men and women walked past the flower bed. <break time="0.8s" /> With a curiously irregular movement. <break time="0.8s" /> Not unlike that of the white and blue butterflies. <break time="0.8s" /> That crossed the turf. <break time="0.8s" /> In zigzag flights from bed to bed. <break time="0.8s" /> A married couple with two children came by the man strolling carelessly. <break time="0.8s" /> About six inches in front of the woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Who now and then turned her head. <break time="0.8s" /> To see that the children were not too far behind. <break time="0.8s" /> The man, whose name was Simon. <break time="0.8s" /> Kept this distance on purpose. <break time="0.8s" /> Though perhaps unconsciously. <break time="0.8s" /> For he wanted to go on with his thoughts. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had been carried back fifteen years. <break time="0.8s" /> To this very garden.
